condition:
Use of HTTP without SSL/TLS:  This smell is the recurring
pattern of using HTTP without the Transport Layer
Security (TLS) or Secure Sockets Layer (SSL). Such use
makes the communication between two entities less
secure.

iterations.rego_code:
package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

http_url_pattern := "(?i)^http://"
ssl_tls_names := {"ssl", "tls", "ssl_enabled", "tls_enabled", "enable_ssl", "enable_tls", "use_ssl", "use_tls"}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match(http_url_pattern, attr.value.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_https",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Use of HTTP without SSL/TLS - Communication should use HTTPS instead of HTTP to ensure encrypted and secure communication. (CWE-319)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    vars := glitch_lib.all_variables(parent)
    v := vars[_]
    v.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match(http_url_pattern, v.value.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_https",
        "element": v,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Use of HTTP without SSL/TLS - Communication should use HTTPS instead of HTTP to ensure encrypted and secure communication. (CWE-319)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == ssl_tls_names[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false

    result := {
        "type": "sec_https",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Use of HTTP without SSL/TLS - SSL/TLS is explicitly disabled. Communication should be encrypted. (CWE-319)"
    }
}

errors.annotation: Semantic validation mismatch between expected and detected lines

iterations.nl_error_summary:
## Summary

**What the rule was attempting to detect:**
The rule aims to flag insecure HTTP usage in IaC configurations — either by matching `http://` URL patterns in string attributes/variables, or by detecting attributes with SSL/TLS-related names explicitly set to `false`.

**What it missed (false negative on line 6):**
The `source` attribute on line 6 contains a Puppet interpolated string (`"http://releases.example.com/app/${version}/app-${version}.tar.gz"`). Because it contains variable interpolations, the IR represents its value not as a flat `String` node but as a nested tree of `Sum` nodes (string concatenation), with the literal `"http://releases.example.com/app/"` buried in the leftmost leaf.

**Why the rule logic failed:**
The rule's first branch checks `attr.value.ir_type == "String"` before applying the regex, but `attr.value.ir_type` is `"Sum"` here, so the condition fails immediately and no match is produced. The rule has no logic to recurse into or unwrap `Sum` trees to inspect the constituent `String` leaves. To fix this, the rule would need to traverse the nested `Sum` structure — for example by checking the leftmost leaf node — or use a helper that reconstructs/partially reconstructs the interpolated string to test whether its static prefix starts with `http://`.
